## What is the feature about?

Adds dense MHA for short prefill in the ROCm AITER Sparse MLA backend, following #47327. Prefill at or below the sparse top-k threshold (2,048 tokens for DeepSeek-V3.2) uses dense attention; longer prefill and decode retain sparse MQA. The fused DeepSeek-V3.2 path is integrated so mixed prefill/decode batches use the correct metadata.

## Test plan

- Compare BF16/FP8-KV engine outputs and log probabilities against forced sparse MQA; cover unequal/chunked prompts, the 2,048-token boundary, and mixed prefill/decode
- Trace the actual pretrained dense/sparse paths separately from timing; run existing metadata, sparse-attention, and sink tests collected by MI300/MI355 CI
- Compare matched pretrained GSM8K/harder-task accuracy and short/long-prompt serving at concurrency 1/8/32

## Test results

Published `7abb8ef` has the same tree as validated `e34b94e`; baseline: `b538d807`. **187 passed, 116 skipped, 14 warnings; local staged pre-commit passed.** Runtime tracing confirmed dense prefill through 2,048 tokens, sparse at 2,049, and mixed dense-prefill/sparse-decode execution.

Pretrained runs: official DeepSeek-V3.2, 8× AMD gfx950/TP8, FP8 weights, BF16 activations/KV, AITER, eager execution, prefix caching off. ROCm 7.2.3, Torch `2.13.0+git733fca1`, AITER 0.1.23, Triton `3.8.0+git669b31ac`.

| Serving: short prompts | TTFT ms, baseline → PR | Paired TTFT change [95% interval] | TPOT/ITL ms | Output tok/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Concurrency 8 | 526.61 → 480.76 | -8.69% [-16.87%, -0.51%] | 160.60 → 158.75 | 48.07 → 48.79 |
| Concurrency 32 | 975.01 → 904.60 | -7.07% [-20.12%, +5.99%] | 143.40 → 139.69 | 198.15 → 204.27 |

Three paired process rounds, fixed 64-token outputs, warmup, 864/864 successful timed requests. These are bounded bursts, with one measured wave at concurrency 32. Long-prompt TTFT was roughly unchanged; short/concurrency-1 throughput decreased 1.23%. Most throughput intervals span zero; these are not production compiled-mode or broad no-regression claims.

| Matched raw-response accuracy | Baseline | PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K 5-shot, strict | 95.38% | 95.53% | +0.15 pp |
| GSM8K 30-shot, strict | 95.30% | 95.38% | +0.08 pp |
| MMLU-Pro, final-answer extraction | 80.13% | 79.69% | -0.45 pp |
| MMLU-Pro, supplementary first-answer extraction | 80.36% | 79.24% | -1.12 pp |

MMLU-Pro is a pinned, category-balanced zero-shot diagnostic, not the full benchmark. At 4,096 output tokens, 37 baseline/45 PR responses hit the cap; selected 8,192-token retries still capped 16/18. Extraction and repeat sensitivity materially limit conclusions. A selected GSM8K control also produced adverse candidate output; its cause remains unresolved. **No equivalence or non-inferiority claim.**

<details>
<summary>Commands and reproduction inputs</summary>

Recorded container layout; baseline uses `/app/workspace/baseline`, PR uses `/app/workspace/repo`, each with its own environment. Run one server at a time. `R` contains local scripts and exact workload/input files that are not publicly attached; these commands are not a standalone public reproduction package. Set `OUT` to a fresh result directory.

```bash
source /app/workspace/env.sh
unset PYTHONPATH PR49263_TRACE_DIR
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
MODEL=/app/workspace/lmeval/model-cache/models--deepseek-ai--DeepSeek-V3.2/snapshots/a7e62ac04ecb2c0a54d736dc46601c5606cf10a6
R=/app/workspace/validation-20261002
cd /app/workspace/repo

HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_sparse_metadata_sync.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_triton_sparse_mla.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_sink.py \
  -q -rs --disable-warnings
.venv/bin/pre-commit run

.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model "$MODEL" --tokenizer "$MODEL" \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v32-pr49263 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18493 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v32 --trust-remote-code --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --seed 42 --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype auto \
  --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 64 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 --no-enable-prefix-caching --enforce-eager \
  --attention-config '{"backend":"ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE"}' --moe-backend aiter
```

Representative serving command (repeat the setup through `cd` in a second shell):

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve \
  --backend vllm --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18493 --model "$MODEL" \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v32-pr49263 --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v32 \
  --dataset-name custom --dataset-path "$R/serving-5shot.jsonl" \
  --skip-chat-template --num-prompts 32 --custom-output-len 64 \
  --ignore-eos --temperature 0 --request-rate inf --max-concurrency 8 \
  --num-warmups 16 --seed 42 --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
  --metric-percentiles 50,90,99 --save-result --save-detailed \
  --result-dir "$OUT" --result-filename 5shot-c8.json --disable-tqdm
```

Use exact saved `serving-5shot.jsonl`/`serving-30shot.jsonl` prompts. Concurrency/request/warmup tuples: `1/8/4`, `8/32/16`, `32/32/64`; three server pairs ordered baseline/PR, PR/baseline, baseline/PR.

The raw client reuses LM Eval prompts/scoring and retains finish reasons/usage and requires `run_accuracy.py`, `gsm8k-{5,30}shot-inputs.json`, and `mmlu-pro-inputs.json`. Use a fresh source label to avoid cached responses:

```bash
# Against baseline; then use replay-candidate-UNIQUE against the PR server.
/app/workspace/lmeval/.venv/bin/python "$R/run_accuracy.py" --source replay-main-UNIQUE
```

</details>

## What is the feature about?

Adds dense MHA for short prefill in the ROCm AITER Sparse MLA backend, following #47327. Prefill at or below the sparse top-k threshold (2,048 tokens for DeepSeek-V3.2) uses dense attention; longer prefill and decode retain sparse MQA. The fused DeepSeek-V3.2 path is integrated so mixed prefill/decode batches use the correct metadata.

## Test plan

- Compare BF16/FP8-KV engine outputs and log probabilities against forced sparse MQA; cover unequal/chunked prompts, the 2,048-token boundary, and mixed prefill/decode
- Trace the actual pretrained dense/sparse paths separately from timing; run existing metadata, sparse-attention, and sink tests collected by MI300/MI355 CI
- Compare matched pretrained GSM8K/harder-task accuracy and short/long-prompt serving at concurrency 1/8/32

## Test results

Published `7abb8ef` has the same tree as validated `e34b94e`; baseline: `b538d807`. **187 passed, 116 skipped, 14 warnings; local staged pre-commit passed.** Runtime tracing confirmed dense prefill through 2,048 tokens, sparse at 2,049, and mixed dense-prefill/sparse-decode execution.

Pretrained runs: official DeepSeek-V3.2, 8× AMD gfx950/TP8, FP8 weights, BF16 activations/KV, AITER, eager execution, prefix caching off. ROCm 7.2.3, Torch `2.13.0+git733fca1`, AITER 0.1.23, Triton `3.8.0+git669b31ac`.
